title: spec+security: reserve the `queues` RLS membership key and resolve `current_user.queues` kernel-side from the ownership-queue service
body:
Filing gate: class ③, maintainer-directed. Child of #25769, filed under ruling `6457475657` (batch #415 item 5, letter **A**, maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-28T00:36Z), which says "the next spec seat files the child". Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017, session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the ruling decides

`queues` joins `RESERVED_RLS_MEMBERSHIP_KEYS`. plugin-security resolves it from the ownership-queue service into `current_user.queues` the same way it resolves `positions`, so there is one kernel-side producer. An app `IRlsMembershipResolver` that supplies `queues` is screened out and fails closed. Option B (plugin-sharing's own resolver) and option C (an ADR-0142 amendment that drops the key) were not chosen.

## Measured on `origin/main` `7eb613c3`

- `packages/spec/src/contracts/rls-membership-resolver.ts:89`: `RESERVED_RLS_MEMBERSHIP_KEYS` = `id`, `organization_id`, `positions`, `org_user_ids`, `accessible_org_ids`, `email`. `queues` is not reserved.
- The ownership-queue runtime landed with #26337 (`packages/objectql/src/ownership-queue.test.ts`, `assignment-rules.ts`). No RLS policy reads `current_user.queues` yet, because the D3 access path goes through the sharing owner match.

## What lands (one PR, size S)

- spec: `queues` added to `RESERVED_RLS_MEMBERSHIP_KEYS`, with its doc comment and the published-list pins that count the keys.
- plugin-security: populate `current_user.queues` (the ids of the queues the user is a member of, directly or through a position or team, as the ownership-queue membership defines) next to `positions`. The value comes from one producer, and the screen drops an app resolver's `queues`.
- Tests: the kernel value appears for a member and is empty for a non-member, and an app resolver that returns `queues` is screened out with the existing fail-closed outcome.

Clause-②: yes (widening). A reserved key is added to a published list. The ruling declares this arm; no accept set an author writes narrows.
Metadata-protocol: none

Out of scope (the rest of the ADR-0142 execution plan on #25769): the HotCRM stopgap deletion, the Console queue picker and Claim affordance, and the authoring guide. The skills docs are #26475.

Dedupe: #25769's comments and open issues mentioning "RESERVED_RLS_MEMBERSHIP_KEYS queues" or "current_user.queues". None found.
